title: RemoteDVR Setup
description: Install RemoteDVR on the car's head unit (or a phone) over USB and grant what it needs. Runs entirely in your browser (WebUSB + ADB).

preInstall.label: Ask RemoteDVR on the car to release the 360 cameras (an update would otherwise leave them stuck until the car sleeps)

postInstall.label: Import the 360 camera libraries from this car
postInstall.detail: copies libais_client, libuhab and libmmosal from /vendor/lib64 into the app's folder (skips files already imported); they stay on the car
commands: D=/sdcard/Android/data/com.nhowka.remotedvr/files/vendor; L=/data/media/0/Android/data/com.nhowka.remotedvr/files/vendor; mkdir -p $D 2>/dev/null; for f in libais_client.so libuhab.so libmmosal.so; do if [ ! -f /vendor/lib64/$f ]; then echo "$f: not on this device"; elif [ -f $D/$f ] && cmp -s /vendor/lib64/$f $D/$f; then echo "$f: already imported"; elif cp /vendor/lib64/$f $D/$f 2>/dev/null || cp /vendor/lib64/$f $L/$f 2>/dev/null; then echo "$f: imported"; else echo "$f: COPY FAILED (open the app once, then retry; the car screen shows whether the 360 libraries are ready)"; fi; done
